text: The Patriots are dealing with some defensive depth concerns heading into Sunday's clash with Jacksonville, as they've ruled out both edge rushers Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) and Quintayvious Hutchins (knee), with the latter now on injured reserve, though cornerback Carlton Davis III is expected to return to the lineup. On a brighter note, rookie tight end Eli Raridon has returned to practice, offering some encouragement about his availability against the Jaguars, while the team continues to work through the kind of clock management issues that plagued them late in the first half over the past two weeks—exactly the sort of self-inflicted mistakes that could prove costly against a Jacksonville offense looking to bounce back from its worst performance in nearly a year. Off the field, Christian Gonzalez and Andy Borregales were among the Patriots contingent celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month at an event in Boston, underscoring the organization's commitment to community engagement even as the roster composition shifts week to week.
